mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% per annum signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates and increasing equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of 20-day windows following UNRATE increases > 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0) and strong industrial production (INDPRO > 100) indicate an overheating economy, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of 20-day windows following UNRATE < 4.0 and INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL annual change > 3.0%), a monthly increase in the CPI index (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflationary pressure, prompting monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of 20-day windows following CPIAUCSL increases during high inflation (CPIAUCSL annual change > 3.0%).

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly growth rate in real GDP (GDPC1) exceeding 2.5% relative to its 5-year average indicates robust economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of 20-day windows following GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 (index 2017=100) indicates weakening manufacturing activity, triggering recessionary fears and negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of 5-day windows following INDPRO readings below 95.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low housing starts (HOUST < 450) and high consumer credit (RSAFS > 300000) indicate a speculative housing bubble, which typically precedes credit tightening and market correction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of 60-day windows following HOUST < 450 and RSAFS > 300000.

mechanism_narrative: In tight labor market regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%), strong monthly employment growth (PAYEMS > 100000) signals sustained economic expansion, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of 20-day windows following PAYEMS increases > 100000 during tight labor market regimes (UNRATE < 4.0%).
